label: ERW forecast
made_rule: made at 22:00 UTC the day before the target local day, after the three day-ahead markets publish on their ordinary timelines, from real-time prices through two days before
units: USD/MWh; mape over the hours whose actual price is at least 5 USD/MWh in size

methods.words: the ERW method the rule chose for the hub (the lowest mean absolute error of yesterday and the regression over the last two years, on the hours the day-ahead price also holds)
the hub's day-ahead price for the hour: the market's own forecast of the real-time price, published before the forecast is made; the comparator, never an ERW method
the real-time price of the same local hour two days before the target day (the latest whole day read)

least squares by local hour on the day-ahead price for the hour, the real-time less day-ahead price at the hour two days before, and its mean over the seven days to then; refit every day on the 730 days before it

cuts.all: every hour of the backtest held by every method and the day-ahead price
cuts.last_2_years: the last 730 days of the backtest (the days the method is chosen on)
cuts.hour: key 0 to 23, the hub's clock, over the last two years
cuts.top10: the ten days of the backtest with the highest real-time price hour
cuts.spike: the hours whose real-time price is above the hub's own 99th percentile over the backtest

hubs.band: the 10th and 90th percentile of the chosen method's own past errors (actual less forecast, USD/MWh) at the same local hour over 365 days

long_backtest.what: the same walk-forward backtest from 1 January 2016, as far back as each hub's prices allow (ERCOT's are held from 2015, SPP's from July 2018, CAISO's real-time prices from July 2023, so their first scored day is as in the backtest): each year scored on the hours every method and the day-ahead price hold; the method chosen now (last two years) is the ERW's in every year, so the earlier years test the rule, they do not choose; the backtest and its cuts above are unchanged

hubs.tomorrow_held: no forecast yet: the day-ahead price for the target day is not held when the forecast is made
